instruction.thesis: HYPE funding crashed to -25.04% annualized at T20 (3.0σ below mean) while OI surged to 1.057B. Per the H-521 promoted setup family, extreme negative funding after a breakout surge signals crowded longs being squeezed and potential momentum deceleration. The spot moved from 46.15 to 46.27 (+0.27%) but the funding flip from +10.95% to -25.04% in a single snapshot is a sharp reversal that historically precedes short-term pullbacks in HYPE breakout setups. The peak PnL was +1.85% at some point during the hour, and current PnL is +0.27%. Given the funding extreme and the position being only 1 hour old with a 503-hour expiry, closing now captures the small gain while avoiding the funding-driven reversal risk. The thesis was momentum continuation on OI surge; the funding crash is a thesis-weakening signal within the allowed evidence columns.
